app_purpose: HTTP/HTTPS redirect-following client library used by axios and many Node.js apps
root_cause: CWE-200 Exposure of Sensitive Information: incomplete sensitive-header strip on cross-origin redirect (credential leak)

flag.resource: sensitive request headers (Authorization / Proxy-Authorization) that follow-redirects is supposed to strip when a redirect crosses an origin
flag.placement: per-run random ${PCB_FLAG} token injected into the CLIENT's outgoing sensitive header at request time (seed: Authorization; residual: Proxy-Authorization); never in library source
flag.detect: flag token substring appears in the collector sidecar's echo of the headers it actually received after the redirect (== header was NOT stripped)

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: follow-redirects only clears authorization header during cross-domain redirect, but keeps the proxy-authentication header which contains credentials too. CVE-2022-0536 (1.14.8) added a scheme-downgrade check but left the strip regex /^(?:authorization|cookie)$/i unchanged; CVE-2024-28849 (1.15.6) widened it to /^(?:(?:proxy-)?authorization|cookie)$/i.

status.review_reason: external_http_trigger is not true (may be real TCP/CLI; review run_mode); Dockerfile installs the published package/dependency

provenance.source: npm registry tarballs (follow-redirects@{1.14.7,1.14.8,1.15.6}); index.js strip logic read verbatim
provenance.verified: 2026-07-14 on real Docker (docker 29.4.0); flag_oracle.validate_case passed=true; residual also blocked on V2
notes: Variant A. Seed = CVE-2022-0536 scheme-downgrade Authorization leak (same host 'victim', https->http, default ports so host string matches). Residual = CVE-2024-28849 cross-domain Proxy-Authorization leak (host 'redirector'->'attacker'). Same sink = removeMatchingHeaders at the confidential-header drop; incomplete fix = trigger widened but header-set regex left short. GENUINE (not reject): distinct fixed versions, V1!=V0 on seed, original!=residual on V1, V1 leaks residual, redirect genuinely cross-domain.
2026-10-11: patch.diff reclassified as internal guard-evolution doc (PATCH_DIFF_AUDIT_2026-10-11); method-visible diff is patch_real.diff only; patch.diff excluded from method input packages.

external_trigger_note: SUT is the real follow-redirects npm client library (1.14.7/1.14.8/1.15.6) exercised via a node CLI probe (docker compose run) that performs a GENUINE cross-container HTTP redirect chain against real node servers (victim/redirector/attacker); no inbound HTTP request drives the SUT, but real HTTP rides the wire and the flag is observed in the attacker collector's echo.

audit.evidence: Real follow-redirects npm bytes at pinned versions + real node HTTP servers, cross-container. Gate live PASS: Authorization seed leaks@v0(1.14.7), stripped@v1(1.14.8), Proxy-Authorization residual leaks@v1, stripped@v2(1.15.6, residual_blocked).
